* Parts that come into contact with food—which explicitly includes **gaskets** (`GSK-SIL-05L` is marked as a food-contact item in Bahi)—may be purchased **only** from a supplier that holds a valid food-grade certificate on file.
* The certificate must be an accredited laboratory test report (e.g., FSSAI-notified) or BIS conformity certificate, uploaded and verified in Bahi before any order can be placed. An uncertified supplier (or one with an expired certificate) cannot be used, regardless of price advantage.
